about: What the broker, the one process that holds the API key, lets a run spend (benchmark/harness/broker.ts; docs/design-review.md, untrusted-test-isolation). The broker reads this file at its start and refuses a request beyond it: a model not named here, more output tokens than maxTokens, a request past maxRequests, or one whose most cost could take the run past its budget or maxDollars, whichever is less. The harness reads its prices, the API version and maxTokens from here too, so that the two cannot drift. Prices are US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic lists them for its first-party API (the claude-api reference, cached 2026-10-06); Haiku's are for prompts of 100K tokens or fewer, which every prompt here is; a cache write costs cacheWrite times the input price, for 5-minute entries.
